abliterated-model.description: Source documentation only (2026-10-09). The vendor Limits table lists 262,144 combined context tokens and 262,134 maximum completion tokens for abliterated-model; maximum output is reachable only with a small prompt. This is the documented general-purpose model with image input. Account-specific availability and live execution are unverified. Other models and protocol families are outside this initial entry.

errorRules.message: Abliteration requires an API key. https://docs.abliteration.ai/api/errors.md documents HTTP 401 for missing or invalid Bearer credentials.
Abliteration documents HTTP 402 for insufficient credits. This is a billing block, not a rate limit. See https://docs.abliteration.ai/api/errors.md.
Abliteration documents HTTP 429 rate limiting and Retry-After at https://docs.abliteration.ai/api/errors.md.

instructions: Create an API key in https://abliteration.ai/console. The public pricing page, retrieved 2026-10-09, states a one-credit free preview without a card; account eligibility and remaining credit are unverified.
Set {apiKeyEnvVar}. The chat endpoint is https://api.abliteration.ai/v1/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer authentication.
This entry includes only abliterated-model. Public documentation describes image input, tools, streamed tools and JSON/schema; vendor and account acceptance remain pending.
Reasoning is on by default at the service. SDK effort/toggle controls and native tool-plus-schema combinations are outside this initial declared scope.
